headline: Approved Painter eligibility list, a two-week extension of Maintainer recruitment, and Lee Palmer as interim HR director.
summary: Recertified two lists and approved job applications for Painter, Police Record Technician, Deputy Fire Marshal, and Maintainer. Certified a Painter eligibility list and extended Maintainer recruitment by two weeks. Appointed Lee Palmer as interim HR director for five months.
decisions: Approved the 9.1.2026 regular meeting minutes, with one abstention.
No action was taken on Fair Rent List #26-10.
No action was taken on Teen Librarian II List #25-22.
Approved one Painter job application, unanimously.
Approved three Police Record Technician job applications, unanimously.
Approved two Deputy Fire Marshal job applications, unanimously.
Approved nineteen Maintainer job applications, unanimously.
Certified eligibility list #26-18 for Painter, unanimously.
Approved a two-week extension of open recruitment for the Maintainer position for PW & Parks, unanimously.
Approved the 8.20.2026 Special Meeting Minutes, unanimously.
Appointed Lee Palmer as Interim HR Director and Executive Secretary for five months, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Commissioner Ward motioned to approve the 9.1.2026 regular meeting minutes. Commissioner Andrews Seconded the motion. Commissioner Lobo abstained. Motion Passes.
Commissioner Andrews motioned to re-certify List #26-09, Central Communications. Commissioner Ward Seconded the motion. Motion Passes unanimously.
Commissioner Ward motioned to re-certify List #25-0921, Maintainer III. Commissioner Andrews Seconded the motion. Motion Passes unanimously.
No action was taken on List #26-10, Fair Rent.
No action was taken on List #25-22, Teen Librarian II.
Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve one (1) Painter application. Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Ward motioned to approve three (3) Police Record Technician applications. Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve two (2) Deputy Fire Marshal applications. Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve nineteen (19) Maintainer applications. Commissioner Lobo seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Lobo motioned to certify eligibility list #26-18, Painter. Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Ward motioned to approve the request to extend the open recruitment for the Maintainer position for two (2) weeks. Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.
Commissioner Lobo motioned to approve the 8.20.2026 Special Meeting Minutes . Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

Commissioner Lobo motioned to approve the appointment of Lee Palmer as Interim Human Resources Director and Executive Secretary to the Civil Service Commission for a five (5) month period. Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. Motion passes unanimously.

plain_text:
TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Civil Service Commission Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
9:00 AM, September 15, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 9:03 a.m. 
2. ATTENDANCE   
 Commissioners in attendance: Curt Andrews, Helen Ward and Andrea Lobo. 
Staff in attendance:  J. Susy Diaz-Callands, Ken Kelley, Lee Palmer, Shelly Carter, Joe 
Collelo and Michael White. 
3. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  1. Review and approval of the CSC regular meeting minutes from 9.1.2026.  
  
• Commissioner Ward motioned to approve the 9.1.2026 regular meeting 
minutes. 
• Commissioner Andrews Seconded the motion. 
• Commissioner Lobo abstained.  
• Motion Passes. 
 
4. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE   
 
 
6. ACTION ITEMS   
 
 
 1. The following list(s) are up for recertification:  
 
• Central Communications List #26-09 
• Maintainer III List #25-21 
• Fair Rent List #26-10 
• Teen Librarian II List #25-22
Commissioner Andrews motioned to re-certify List #26-09, Central Communications.  
Commissioner Ward Seconded the motion. 
Motion Passes unanimously. 
 
Commissioner Ward motioned to re-certify List #25-0921, Maintainer III.  
Commissioner Andrews Seconded the motion. 
Motion Passes unanimously. 
 
No action was taken on List #26-10, Fair Rent. 
 
No action was taken on List #25-22, Teen Librarian II. 
 2. Review and approval of the following job applications: 
• Painter. 
• Police Record Technician. 
• Deputy Fire Marshal. 
• Maintainer.  
 
       
  
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve one (1) Painter application. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
 
• Commissioner Ward motioned to approve three (3) Police Record Technician 
applications. 
• Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
 
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve two (2) Deputy Fire Marshal 
applications. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
 
• Commissioner Andrews motioned to approve nineteen (19) Maintainer 
applications. 
• Commissioner Lobo seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously.
3. Certify the following Eligibility list(s): 
•  #26-18 Painter 
 
       
  
• Commissioner Lobo motioned to certify eligibility list #26-18, Painter. 
• Commissioner Ward seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
 4. Correspondence from Joe Colello requesting to extend the open recruitment for the 
position of Maintainer for PW & Parks. 
       
  
• Commissioner Ward motioned to approve the request to extend the open 
recruitment for the Maintainer position for two (2) weeks. 
• Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 
 
8. REPORTS   
 
 
9. OLD BUSINESS   
 
• Commissioner Lobo motioned to approve the 8.20.2026 Special Meeting Minutes . 
• Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
10. NEW BUSINESS   
 
 
  1. Appointment of Lee Palmer as Interim HR Director and Executive Secretary to the 
Civil Service Commission.   
  
• Commissioner Lobo motioned to approve the appointment of Lee Palmer as 
Interim Human Resources Director and Executive Secretary to the Civil 
Service Commission for a five (5) month period. 
• Commissioner Andrews seconded the motion. 
• Motion passes unanimously. 
 
11. ADJOURNMENT   
 9:23 a.m.
